_comment: Copy this file to ~/.config/apple-reminders/config.json and fill in your own values. NEVER commit the real config.json — it contains app-specific passwords. Keep it chmod 600.
_required_for_read: Apple ID + app-specific password (NOT your Apple ID password). Generate one at https://appleid.apple.com/account/manage > Security > App-Specific Passwords.
_required_for_write_email_trigger: Gmail account + Gmail app password used to send the silent trigger email that fires the iOS Shortcut. trigger_email_to is the iCloud address the iOS Personal Automation watches.
_optional_for_cleanup: Used by 'reminders cleanup' to delete trigger emails from the iCloud Inbox. icloud_imap_user is the same iCloud address as trigger_email_to. icloud_imap_app_password is a SEPARATE app-specific password (generated at appleid.apple.com) for IMAP access.
